name: sdlc-intelligence-deep
description: SDLC judgment, independent engineering Skills, and a thin outcome-oriented Codex session kernel without a central Delivery router.

interface.longDescription: Independent SDLC, product, design, engineering, QA, operations, documentation, and delivery Skills plus a thin Codex-native session kernel for source-first work, progressive context use, same-session capability composition, decision-dense communication, and proportional proof. Native Skill discovery selects capabilities; Skill activation is not a handoff, and the plugin does not reproduce a central Delivery router or host agent runtime.
capabilities: Editable BPMN and Flowchart process diagrams
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository from verified source before proposing changes.
Plan the smallest executable engineering frontier for this change.
Diagnose this failure from runtime evidence before implementing a fix.
